description:
A per-test limit names the slow test, where a suite total only says the suite got slower. This makes the per-layer limits the enforced bound, and in the same change removes the suite-duration budget they replace, so test speed is never left unenforced.

## Background

`.config/nextest.toml` holds the per-test timeout. `scripts/rust-build-budget.sh` enforces `MAX_TEST_SUITE_SECONDS=30` over a suite clock that `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` measures and passes as `--test-suite-ms`. `scripts/cargo-ci.sh`'s exit-classification header treats a suite-duration-only overrun at high load as environment-sensitive. The budget is also described in:
- the `cargo-ci` gate description in `.jit/gates.toml`, and its projection in `docs/reference/rules-and-gates.md`;
- `dev/TESTING.md`;
- the suite clock row in `dev/benchmarks/rust-build-budgets/README.md`.
It is tested by the self-tests in `scripts/rust-build-budget.sh` and `scripts/cargo-ci-selftest.sh`, and by `crates/jit/tests/scratch_build/build_profile_policy_tests.rs`.

A cold doctest compile inside the suite clock is among the false failures this removes: on 2026-11-04 ceaaf0ab's landing overran the 30 s suite budget at 38.9 s because its doctest step took 25 s cold (3 s warm), with every test passing.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The nextest configuration enforces the per-layer limits recorded in the per-test benchmark note, using test-kind or filter overrides, so a test over its layer's limit fails the run and is named in the output.
- [hard] REQ-02: The whole-suite duration budget is gone: `MAX_TEST_SUITE_SECONDS`, the suite-duration check and the `--test-suite-ms` input in `scripts/rust-build-budget.sh`, the suite clock in `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` that feeds it, and the suite-duration clauses of `cargo-ci.sh`'s exit-classification header. The integration-target, executable-byte, profile and dependency-feature budgets stay.
- [hard] REQ-03: The self-tests and Rust tests that owned the suite-duration policy are removed or rewritten to own the per-test limit, with no test left asserting the retired budget.
- [hard] REQ-04: The `cargo-ci` gate description in `.jit/gates.toml` (and its generated projection), `dev/TESTING.md` and the suite clock row of `dev/benchmarks/rust-build-budgets/README.md` describe the per-test limits. No live prose, comment or open criterion outside archived history and recorded benchmark output cites the 30 s suite budget.
- [hard] REQ-05: A test of the nextest configuration or the budget tooling shows that a test over its layer's limit fails the run.

## Decisions

- D-01: The whole-suite duration budget is retired in favour of the per-test limits (user ruling, 2026-11-03; charter D-18).

## Notes

A per-test timeout at high host load keeps its existing environment-sensitive classification. Recorded benchmark runs, archived epics and the changelog are history and stay as written.
title: Enforce the per-test limits and retire the whole-suite budget
